issue: Regulatory statement claims a matter was 'searched and verified' with no evidence id behind it
neutral_rule: A claim of having searched must carry the search scope, the source types covered and a resolvable evidence id; an unbacked 'verified' is a narrative assertion, not a finding.
retest_at_head: 14 Aug P0 with no re-test record and no evidence id; re-test at HEAD before seeding any gate.

issue: A dated regulatory item renders a date the source does not state
neutral_rule: Every rendered date resolves to a stated date in the cited source; an inferred or defaulted date is UNVERIFIED and renders as such, never as fact.
retest_at_head: 14 Aug finding, no re-test record.

issue: A REMEDIATED matter drew as still open while its drilldown said the opposite
neutral_rule: A record's lifecycle status is identical at card face, detail tab, status arrow and drilldown; no arrow is derived from anything but the stored status field.
retest_at_head: SHIPPED DEFECT 4. Re-test at HEAD.

issue: Analyst Alerts reports zero open alerts across zero entities while Dashboard reports 109
neutral_rule: The open-alert count is one number at every surface that draws it and equals the number the promote gate counted; a run promotes only below the ceiling.
retest_at_head: The doc calls this a P1 blocker at line 24 and 'reconciled' at line 1947 - the same number cannot be both. ALERT_CEILING=15 is enforced at promote at HEAD; the three-way render reconciliation is not.

issue: A run promoted carrying 98 open alerts because nothing counted them
neutral_rule: Promotion counts open alerts from the payload about to be written and blocks at 15 or more.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: ALERT_CEILING = 15 enforced in promote with a test asserting the ceiling. Carried as a regression guard.

issue: A shared contract was absent from the api image and the loader swallowed FileNotFoundError into an empty dict
neutral_rule: Every shared contract a service reads is proven present inside the BUILT IMAGE, and the loader raises rather than degrading to an empty mapping.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: CI Gate D ships shared contracts into the image; the gap loader raises FileNotFoundError. Regression guard.

issue: A contract path was built eagerly at parents[3], raising IndexError in the 3-deep image layout
neutral_rule: Contract path resolution is lazy and depth-independent; no module computes a fixed parent index at import time, and every module is imported under the image's directory depth in CI.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: a repo-wide scanning test exists. Regression guard.

issue: 32 field paths null on 100% of rows; 23 of them contract-asked and gated by nothing
neutral_rule: Every contract-asked ITEM key sits in a must_present set or a recorded waiver; a submit-time census blocks any asked path null across all rows, naming the path and the row count.
retest_at_head: PARTIALLY closed at HEAD: must_present machinery exists in validation but is declared on only ~3 field specs in the registry. The ITEM-key census gate and the registry-coverage ratchet are NOT yet enforced.

issue: 43 of 51 technology cards asserted 'this run states no peer set' while the run named five
neutral_rule: A negative-state sentence is bound to the key that carries the fact it denies; the sentence may not render when that key is non-empty.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: peer_deployments is read by the tech rows. The durable read-key/write-key gate does NOT exist.

issue: The adapter read cap_level, a key no contract declares, while capped_subcap_ids had zero readers
neutral_rule: Every key a client module reads is declared by a contract and written by an adapter; every contract-declared field has at least one reader. Both directions fail the build.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: capped_subcap_ids is now read. The gate that prevents recurrence does NOT exist.

issue: 25 platform peer_deployment rows, each carrying a fully cited basis, rendered zero times
neutral_rule: A promoted array with N>0 rows renders N>0 rows, or its omission is recorded with a reason; served set and rendered set are diffed rather than counted.
retest_at_head: Same class as BAX-09 and BAX-10. Re-test the render-count assertion per array field for BOTH promoted clients.

issue: A HELD firmographic quarantined with a 297-character reason rendered no row at all
neutral_rule: A field with a recorded held reason renders its row and the substance of the reason, in reader language; a value that genuinely cannot be sourced omits its row entirely.
retest_at_head: SHIPPED DEFECT 7. Re-test at HEAD - the enrichment-render suite exists but held-with-reason coverage must be confirmed.

issue: A null percentage formatted as '0%'; a stated zero printed identically to an unstated value
neutral_rule: Null in, null out for every formatter; a stated zero is visibly distinct from an unstated value; no formatter returns a sentinel that reads as a measurement.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: fmtPct(null) returns null and fmtAssets(0) prints '$0' distinctly from unstated. Regression guard.

issue: A duplicate CAGR row - pinned from the computed series and printed again by the passthrough
neutral_rule: The pinned-ROW list and the pinned-KEY list are one list; a slot that is pinned is excluded from passthrough, asserted by a duplicate-slot scan on the rendered panel.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: one CAGR row - computed wins, stated falls back with its own basis. Regression guard.

issue: blocking_findings promoted as JSON-encoded strings; CG-03 is structurally unable to see it
neutral_rule: No payload leaf may be a string that PARSES as a JSON object or array; the predicate is narrow and needs its own gate rather than a widening of the type check.
retest_at_head: FIXED at HEAD: CG-21 walks every leaf and refuses serialised JSON, with the reasoning recorded in validation.py. Regression guard.

issue: Four render fixes reported live when the deployed revision was built 58 minutes before they were committed
neutral_rule: A fix is reported live only after the deployed revision's build timestamp and source commit are compared against the commit containing it, and the served bytes are compared against a local build of HEAD. 'Could not compare' is a FAIL.
retest_at_head: OPEN AT HEAD - the genuine hole. scripts/verify_deployed.py EXISTS but is referenced by neither .github/workflows/ci.yml nor infra/. Nothing enforces it.

issue: CI ran apps/worker and apps/mcp only; the API's 251 tests and the whole web suite had never run
neutral_rule: The set of CI test targets equals the set of test directories discovered in the tree; a suite no job names fails the build; a required production-path test that SKIPS fails the job.
retest_at_head: PARTIALLY fixed at HEAD: python-tests now runs worker, mcp, api and scripts; web-tests builds the proto bundle and runs the web suite. STILL ABSENT: lint, type checks, accessibility, the browser QA gate and authenticated deployment smoke.

issue: Five components are defined, exported and mounted nowhere, including a 2,694-line page pack shipped to every browser
neutral_rule: Every component defined in a page pack is mounted on a route or deleted; no page pack ships to the browser unmounted; a declared surface resolving to no mounted component is EXCLUDE with grep evidence, never a silent pass.
retest_at_head: OPEN AT HEAD. CoverageByPillarCard, EvidenceTierCard, CeilingEstimateCard, FinancialTrajectoryCard and LiveClientPage each have exactly 6 grep hits - definition, comment, export and their compiled twins. CI Gate C covers em-dash dead ends, not dead components.

issue: A capability drill returned its parent category's whole 40-cell set
neutral_rule: A drill returns exactly the grain that was clicked; a parent-wide result at a child grain is a grain defect and blocks release.
retest_at_head: 14 Aug FAIL, no re-test record.

issue: A category label rendered empty on the grid
neutral_rule: Every rendered cell carries a non-empty label sourced from the catalogue; a blank label is a payload defect, not a render nit.

issue: Focus-area cards shipped as clickable divs with no role, accessible name or keyboard tab stop
neutral_rule: Every activatable card exposes a role, an accessible name and a keyboard tab stop, and is operable by Enter and Space.
retest_at_head: 14 Aug FAIL.

issue: Source locators rendered as plain text rather than links
neutral_rule: A source locator renders as an actual link with its href resolving to the cited source.
retest_at_head: 14 Aug FAIL on Heatmap and focus detail.

issue: Export completion could not be proven on Heatmap, Platform and the scorecard export
neutral_rule: An export that cannot be proven complete is BLOCKED, never PASS; the produced artefact is captured and its mode, filters, client, run, audience and uncertainty disclosure asserted.

issue: Displayed rank did not follow displayed composite score on the platform affinity cards
neutral_rule: Rank IS the sort: a ranked list is ordered by the displayed score before render, at every ranked surface.
retest_at_head: The SAME class was fixed on the Overview opportunity surface at HEAD by sorting before render. Re-test whether the platform list received the same fix.

issue: Stacked overlays shipped duplicate accessible Close names
neutral_rule: Each overlay in a stack exposes a distinct accessible name on its close control, and focus returns to the exact opener.

issue: Thin-evidence alerts reported zero thin cells with no denominator or eligibility rule proven
neutral_rule: A zero is accepted only when its denominator and eligibility rule are shown; a zero that nothing computed is indistinguishable from a zero nothing counted.

issue: The promoted run carries an empty safeguard-gates array and no gate fixture exercises the other states
neutral_rule: not-run, unavailable, failed, waived and passed are five distinct states with fixtures for each; a failing safeguard discloses and still promotes, a failing evidence reason never does.
retest_at_head: Emptiness is real at HEAD. The doc's '93 committed client packages' denominator cannot exist and must not seed the fixture.

issue: The Health alert register still reads the legacy deriver rather than the promoted alerts section
neutral_rule: A register that a payload section produces is read from that section; a legacy deriver walking flags is switched off, not left as a silent fallback.
retest_at_head: The doc asserts as FACT that the deriver is switched off. At HEAD the page still calls it. The doc records a fix that did not happen.

issue: The Prospecting page crashes
neutral_rule: No route may throw during render; an error boundary renders a named error state and the failure is reported.
retest_at_head: Re-tested: STILL LIVE at HEAD.

issue: Import Audit renders stale data
neutral_rule: A surface that reads a cached or derived view declares the view's as-of and refuses to render a value older than its declared bound.
retest_at_head: Re-tested: STILL LIVE at HEAD.

issue: The trigger-rerun control is a stub that reports completion without performing a write
neutral_rule: A control that reports completion proves the write; a client-side toast is not a submit.
retest_at_head: Re-tested: STILL LIVE at HEAD. Same class as the intake modal's fake submit.

issue: A non-native switch control is used where a native control is required
neutral_rule: Interactive controls use native elements or expose the full ARIA pattern including keyboard operation and state.
retest_at_head: Re-tested: STILL LIVE at HEAD.

issue: Search matches name and domain while the contract requires name and display ID
neutral_rule: The searchable field set is stated in the contract and asserted against the matcher; a check may not assert a behaviour nobody built without recording the gap.
retest_at_head: The doc calls this P0 against an unimplemented behaviour. Either the matcher gains display id or the contract is corrected - this is a genuine spec-vs-implementation conflict for the owner.

issue: Uncertainty-band category counts do not reconcile to actual category-cell counts
neutral_rule: A stated rationale's leaf count and the actual leaf count agree at every grain, zero tolerance; counts are recomputed from the served cell set, never restated.
retest_at_head: The doc's '169 scored subcaps versus an actual 36' is one instance. Measure at test time; never hard-code the figure.

issue: CSV export has no formula-injection or delimiter test despite a subsection named for it
neutral_rule: CSV cells beginning =, +, -, @, tab or CR are neutralised; embedded quotes, commas and newlines round-trip; encoding is asserted.
retest_at_head: The subsection's accept clause is numeric-recompute boilerplate copy-pasted from another surface. Nothing in it tests injection.

issue: Tech Stack evidence surfaces carry the Heatmap cell-evidence contract verbatim
neutral_rule: A surface's required-content list is derived from its own contract; a detection record has no cell score and no cross-cell supports relation, and asserting them would invent fields.

issue: Nine surfaces carry NOT YET RE-EXECUTED and no live result at all
neutral_rule: An unexecuted surface is UNVERIFIED and blocks release; UNVERIFIED is never reported as PASS and never omitted from the exit count.

issue: Twelve section-8.4 headings repeat an unfalsifiable cohesion sentence naming no field, path or arithmetic
neutral_rule: A cohesion check names the inbound fact, the outbound consumer and the identity that must hold - same anchor cell id, same run id, same denominator at origin and destination.

issue: The loophole register encodes a named promoted client, ten of its URLs and its figures as expected output
neutral_rule: No client fact, name, URL or figure appears in a fixture or an expected value; the reference institution is evidence of one implementation state, never a universal narrative.
retest_at_head: The register's own scope note forbids this and its counterchecks 1-6 do it anyway, without the non-normative caveat.

issue: Every surface claims an ATTACHED screenshot as its evidence record while its own 8.2 says a screenshot cannot prove provenance
neutral_rule: The acceptance artefact is a retained DOM and payload dump keyed by qa_id; the image is illustration only. A screenshot of an absent surface is an image of a page, not evidence about the surface.
retest_at_head: The delivered markdown carries 100 placeholder image refs with no image data, so no screenshot assertion in the doc is verifiable from the artefact itself. Five sections claim ATTACHED for surfaces they simultaneously report as absent.

issue: Only one promoted client is exercised; cross-client checks have no second fixture
neutral_rule: Every client-variation check runs against BOTH promoted clients, or declares itself a synthetic fixture; a nine-sub-vertical fixture matrix over two real clients can only be synthetic and must say so.
retest_at_head: The owner's instruction is to stress-test against TWO promoted clients. The qa-gate default targets a single reference entity.
